product.title: Helicopter Tour of the North Canyon with Optional Hummer Excursion

description.text: Lift off from the Grand Canyon South Rim Heliport on a Bell helicopter flight over Kaibab National Forest and into the Dragon Corridor, the deepest and widest section of the canyon. An optional Hummer ground tour adds South Rim viewpoints after landing back in Tusayan.

highlights: 25-minute North Canyon helicopter flight from the South Rim Heliport
Aerial routing through the Dragon Corridor over the inner gorge
Optional add-on Hummer tour of South Rim viewpoints
State-of-the-art Bell helicopter with window views for every passenger
Seamless transfer to ground tour when the Hummer option is selected

start.description: Check in at Papillon Helicopters, 3568 Airport Rd, Grand Canyon Village, AZ 86023. Arrive 30 minutes before your scheduled departure.

end.description: Return to the Papillon terminal after landing; Hummer add-on guests transfer to the ground tour staging area.

product.itinerarySummary: Lift off from the Grand Canyon South Rim Heliport on a Bell helicopter flight over Kaibab National Forest and into the Dragon Corridor, the deepest and widest section of the canyon.

itineraryItems.title: Kaibab National Forest
itineraryItems.description: Depart over ponderosa pine forest on the South Rim plateau before reaching the canyon edge.

itineraryItems.title: Dragon Corridor
itineraryItems.description: Fly through the Dragon Corridor, the deepest and widest section of the Grand Canyon.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon North Rim
itineraryItems.description: Aerial views toward the North Rim and inner gorge from the helicopter cabin.

itineraryItems.title: Colorado River
itineraryItems.description: Track the Colorado River bend visible from the North Canyon flight path.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon South Rim
itineraryItems.description: Optional Hummer tour stops at South Rim viewpoints after the helicopter lands.

inclusions: Helicopter air tour from Grand Canyon South Rim Heliport
Optional Hummer tour with driver-guide when selected
additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Helicopter Tour of the North Canyon with Optional Hummer Excursion?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 25 minutes to 4 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at the Grand Canyon?
faqs.answer: Check in at Papillon Helicopters, 3568 Airport Rd, Grand Canyon Village, AZ 86023. Arrive 30 minutes before your scheduled departure.
